name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.37.0: accounts from the lease form. /api/v1/operators/provision takes contactName, so the invite email greets the aðalnotandi named on skraning.agvending.is rather than the company, and it never invites anyone to an operator that already exists. An operator created from the form has a kennitala but no Payday customer yet (the Zap creates that afterwards), so its invoices and ledger now resolve the Payday customer by kennitala the first time they are opened and store the link. Cumulative over v6.36.1.
